summary: Myst entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Myst
entries.definitive_edition: Myst (2021) for normal play; original/Masterpiece for historical presentation

emulation.notes: Native PC route for Myst (2021). Use original releases only for historical presentation checks.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Modern PC flat-screen or VR rendering

primary.why: Cyan's modern Myst release is built for flat-screen and VR play and is the strongest fidelity route for a normal archive playthrough. The original 1993 release remains the preservation route for exact slideshow/FMVs and historical interface behavior.
primary.how_to_play: Use Myst (2021) on Windows from Steam/GOG/Epic with the current patch. Use the original/Masterpiece route only when the goal is exact 1993 presentation.

all_releases.fidelity: Original CD-ROM slideshow presentation and historical interface.
all_releases.reason: skip: historically authoritative, but lower fidelity than the modern remake for normal play.

all_releases.platform: Saturn / PlayStation / Jaguar CD / CD-i / 3DO / AmigaOS and other ports
all_releases.fidelity: Console and computer ports of the original presentation with platform-specific compromises.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced exclusive story content over the PC routes.
skip: useful comparison path, but Myst (2021) is the current official high-fidelity route.

all_releases.platform: Myst (2021) on Windows / Mac / Xbox / VR
all_releases.fidelity: Modern realtime 3D remake with flat-screen and VR support.
all_releases.reason: primary: best current fidelity route from Cyan.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Myst (2021) is the fidelity route, while the original/Masterpiece releases preserve the exact 1993 look and interface.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not treat the remake as a perfect replacement for the original capture style. Log whether the archive is preserving original FMV/slideshow behavior or modern free-look presentation.

entries.title: Riven
entries.definitive_edition: Riven (2024) for high-fidelity play; original/Masterpiece Edition for historical presentation

emulation.notes: Use native PC for the remake; original route may use ScummVM/DOSBox or classic compatibility depending on source.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current realtime 3D remake, with original route documented separately

primary.version: Riven (2024) remake with original route documented separately
primary.why: Cyan's 2024 Riven is the current high-fidelity route, rebuilt as a realtime 3D remake for modern PC and VR. The original 1997 slideshow/FMVs, puzzle logic, and interface remain a distinct preservation route and should be captured separately when exact historical behavior matters.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Riven remake on PC for the main route. Record build/storefront, flat-screen or VR mode, movement/camera settings, puzzle-assist/accessibility state, ending route, and whether the original 1997/Masterpiece Edition route was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original slideshow/FMVs, interface, and puzzle behavior
secondary.why: The remake expands and changes the experience rather than replacing the original exactly.

all_releases.fidelity: Realtime 3D remake with expanded/reimagined presentation and VR support.
all_releases.reason: primary: current high-fidelity route from Cyan.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Riven (2024) is the fidelity/current route, while the 1997 original is the exact-historical route and has different presentation/puzzle behavior.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not treat the remake as a one-to-one replacement; record whether the run targets remake or original behavior.
